body: From the Windows node (arx-platform side), Brian's rule 2026-10-08: Hall9k is the source of truth, the tracker is its outflow; every Jira card or GitHub issue gets an h9k record, at least a Draft. Spun-off sessions hand the h9k write to the project orchestrator, and write it themselves only when it is unreachable. Filed idea d8fe408e and draft bf4b0c12 (orchestrator-recipe-generator hand-over rule) in hall9k for triage; nothing published or assigned. Please apply the same rule to the Mac node's recipes and sessions.
